learning_outcomes.title: Analyse monic trinomial factors
learning_outcomes.statement: Factor trinomials of the form x² + bx + c.
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: For (x+r)(x+s), r+s=b and rs=c. Enumerate integer factor pairs.

questions.instruction: Which expression does not belong because it cannot be factored using integers?
questions.stem: Which expression does not belong because it cannot be factored using integers?

options.misconception: Choose a pair that sums to 11 only by guessing; 3 and 8 do work, so this one factors.
Sign slip on the middle term; -12 and 2 do work, so this one factors.
Check the sum of the pair: 6 and -4 do work, so this one factors.

answer.explanation: x²+12x+24: no integer pair has product 24 and sum 12 (the discriminant 48 is not a perfect square). The other three factor into integer binomials: (x+3)(x+8), (x−12)(x+2), (x+6)(x−4).
